title: Guacamole
description: Chunky, fresh, perfect every time. Adapted from Serious Eats / Kenji López-Alt.
steps: Halve avocados, remove pit. Scoop into bowl.
Add lime juice and salt. Mash to desired consistency.
Fold in cilantro, onion, jalapeño, garlic.
Taste and adjust lime and salt.
Press plastic wrap directly on surface. Serve within a few hours.
notes: Salt brings out flavor - don't skimp.
source: Adapted from Serious Eats / Kenji López-Alt
